a: Merging the image and audio runs drops the image run's `at`, so Step never outlines its stage in a pipeline with audio stages
A param slider records its live preview values as undo steps, so a canceled drag leaves a no-op "Set <label>" step and a paused drag splits into several
Source images are never closed: a replaced source, the test card, and the last source on unmount all leak their ImageBitmap
b: ParamPanel records a slider's live `onInput` values as undo steps, so one drag can become several steps and a canceled drag leaves a no-op step
Adding a stage from the palette leaves the previously picked group armed for Ungroup
Chosen source images are never closed: each replacement, and the one held at unmount, leaks an ImageBitmap
Leaving pipeline mode while an audio file decodes shows a spurious "Could not read the audio" toast
